resources.string: Every instrument gets its own fixed place in the room, re-rendered in real time. Apps that can\'t be re-rendered automatically use Standard.
Head tracking applied directly to every app, with no added delay. Best for video lip-sync.
Finds the best stage and room for each song
The front camera follows your head; the gyroscope fills in between frames. Nothing is recorded.
Uses only the phone\'s motion. Keep the phone in a pocket so it turns with you.
Sound stays put even when the phone moves
Scene slowly follows you to a new direction
Pause Camera When Screen Is Off

For the cleanest sound, turn off Dolby Atmos or other spatial effects in your phone\'s sound settings while Immersive 3D is on. When Android asks to share your screen, choose \"Entire screen\": only audio is used, and nothing is recorded or leaves your phone.\n\nHRTF data: MIT Media Lab KEMAR (Gardner & Martin).
